release_notes: Mac auto-update bridge. 1.2.15/1.2.16 failed on v1.2.17 with “Mounted image has no Universal.app” (rename to Abaco Harness.app). This DMG still includes Universal.app on a Universal volume so those old updaters can apply. If you are stuck on 1.2.15 or 1.2.16 you can also drag Abaco Harness.app to /Applications once; after this release later auto-updates work.
